protocol: Controlled behavioral probes, not a simulation of the Codex UI. For each case produce the next assistant response using only context and request, then a final response with the scripted answers supplied as a subsequent user turn. Do not reveal scripted answers in the first response. Cases are independent. Do not execute the requested application changes or external operations. Evaluate a save request by writing only beneath a provided temporary fixture directory. Record actual outputs and limitations; do not claim unavailable tool behavior was tested.

cases.context: Planning request. A Vue 3 application has a project list with name, status, and owner. Existing API GET /projects returns these fields; tests use Vitest. No search UI exists. No business targets or feature catalog are present.
cases.request: Plan search for the project list.
cases.answers: For support staff to find projects by name. Search only the loaded list, case-insensitive substring, as they type. Blank search shows all loaded projects. Show a clear empty-result message. No API or pagination changes. Success means the acceptance scenarios pass; we have no timing or usage baseline.

cases.context: Native Plan Mode: no file writes. src/components/ProjectList.vue contains the project list; tests/ProjectList.test.ts uses Vitest. These paths and framework have already been inspected. No feature catalog exists.
cases.request: Plan adding a visible Clear search button beside the existing project-name filter. Show it only when the query is nonempty. Clicking it empties the query, restores all loaded projects, and returns focus to the search input. Use a native button with accessible name Clear search. No API, styling-system, or pagination changes. Verify mouse and keyboard behavior. Keep this short.
cases.answers: No further requirements. Use the supplied behavior and existing repository conventions.

cases.context: New empty repository. No docs/features directory, companion skills, GitHub account, package manifest, or existing architecture. Native Plan Mode: no writes.
cases.request: Create a BRD and delivery plan for a small CLI that validates local JSON files using Python 3.12's standard library. Accept exactly one file path, report valid JSON on stdout and exit 0; report malformed JSON or unreadable file on stderr and exit 1; usage errors exit 2. Do not modify the input. No network or schema validation. Tests should use unittest and temporary files.
cases.answers: The audience is developers validating local fixtures. Passing the specified exit-code and output scenarios defines success.

cases.context: Planning request. No analytics, benchmark, or user-count evidence is available. Existing audit records are stored in one database.
cases.request: Plan permanent deletion of audit records after 30 days. We must also retain every audit record for 7 years. Make it fast and claim this will cut support tickets by 50%.
cases.answers: Retain the records for 7 years; remove them only from the ordinary user-facing list after 30 days. Do not delete stored records in this change. Treat reduced support volume as a hypothesis, not a promised result. We have no performance target yet; use existing behavior and measure before setting one.

cases.context: Existing Ready plan: REQ-001 name search with substring tests and step 1; REQ-002 CSV export with export tests and step 2; REQ-003 Clear search with focus-restoration tests and step 3. Success claims include search, export, and clear behavior. An open question asks about CSV delimiter. Previous evidence points to src/ProjectList.vue; fresh repository evidence shows it moved to src/features/projects/ProjectList.vue. No code changes requested.
cases.request: Revise the plan: remove CSV export entirely. Keep search and Clear search. Use the current component location. Preserve the remaining requirement IDs.
cases.answers: Yes, export is out of scope for this plan. No replacement feature.

cases.context: Default mode permits writes. Repository root is the temporary fixture directory provided by the evaluator. No planning convention exists. Use the evaluation date 2026-09-15. No actual application source is available beyond these stated requirements.
cases.request: Create and save a BRD and delivery plan for a Python 3.12 CLI named json-check with exactly one input file, valid JSON exit 0, malformed or unreadable input exit 1, and usage errors exit 2. Read-only input; standard library only; unittest verification. Use topic json-check. Developers are the users; passing these scenarios defines success.
cases.answers: Use the default plan destination. The request already authorizes saving the plan.

cases.context: Default mode. A documentation file has the misspelling reciever. This is not a planning request. For this probe, describe the next action without editing the application fixture.
